messages:
emma: FYI the sample edge-worker fails in CF with a weird prototype error when importing our JS SDK. 
ryan: paste exact error?
emma: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prototype')` on new Client() only in worker.
lu: that smells like CJS artifact landed in runtime. which entry did the worker resolve?
emma: our exports map: . -> { types, import: ./dist/esm/index.mjs, require: ./dist/cjs/index.cjs } and main -> dist/cjs/index.cjs.
ryan: many edge runtimes still follow main or bundlers rewrite. if the ESM bundle accidentally contains `require()` calls it can fail too.
lu: check the auth helper we ship. it conditionally loads node-fetch via require() in Node path. if transforms didn't strip it from ESM artifact that explains it.
emma: confirmed: esm output has a stray `require('node-fetch')` inside the compiled auth file.
ryan: action items: 1) make esm build pure (no require/module.exports) 2) add CI lint to scan dist/esm for `require(` and fail if found 3) add explicit `"./types": {"types": "./dist/index.d.ts"}` export so TS resolution is deterministic
lu: also add `browser` field in exports to bias bundlers to esm for browser/edge consumers.
emma: short-term mitigation: set "main" -> dist/esm/index.mjs in a patch release to reduce edge breakage until fixes land. watch out this can break legacy CJS `require()` users.
build-bot: ci/checks  added esm-scan and tsc-resolution checks to matrix on PR #501
ryan: let's also add a tiny cloudflare worker repro to sample-apps and run it in CI emulation so we catch regressions.
emma: I'll open the repro + docs PR. thanks folks :thumbsup:
